seed_streams: np.random.default_rng for each of np.random.SeedSequence(1911).spawn(8); torch seeds are the candidate seeds themselves

inputs.synthetic_latents: N(0,1) float32, seed 1911 streams (E1: stream 1, E4: streams 2 and 3)

oracle_assumption: E1-E4 use one known plaintext/ciphertext pair (T3 KPA). E5/E6 use ciphertext only (T1 COA): a single exact ciphertext latent. In all experiments the secret seed is planted inside the reduced range, so the controls verify the search and the oracle, not the base rate of a real attack.

e1_s0_naive_d4096.description: S0, brute force over seeds [0, 2^20), full 4096-dim candidate keys regenerated with RademacherKey._generate_key
e1_s0_naive_d4096.oracle: known pair (z, z_enc); candidate k accepted iff k (.) z == z_enc exactly (equivalent to k == sign(z_enc*z) because z has no zero)

e2_s0_full_d65536_screened.description: S0 at the real latent size d = 65536, seeds [0, 2^20); 64-coordinate prefix screen, survivors verified on all coordinates
e2_s0_full_d65536_screened.latent: real E2.3 inversion latent, index 0 of latents.npy
e2_s0_full_d65536_screened.oracle: screen: first 64 key coordinates == sign(z_enc*z); verify: k (.) z == z_enc on all 65536 coordinates
e2_s0_full_d65536_screened.analytic_false_survivor_rate: [fact] a 64-coordinate prefix screen matches a random key with probability 2^-64; over the full 2^32 seed space the expected false survivors are 2^32 * 2^-64 = 2^-32

e3_negative_control.description: same search as E2 over the whole [0, 2^20) range, but z_enc was produced with a seed outside the range; nothing may be found
e3_negative_control.secret_seed_draw: same rng as E1, draw 3, integers(2^20, 2^32)

e4_s1_split_search.description: S1 with independent sign seed and permutation seed (password-mode structure), each in [0, 2^18), d = 4096; known pair -> exact (k, pi) via magnitude ordering and signs, then the two seeds are searched separately
e4_s1_split_search.latent: synthetic N(0,1) float32 with pairwise distinct magnitudes (asserted)
e4_s1_split_search.secret_seed_draw: same rng as E1, draws 4 and 5
e4_s1_split_search.note: [fact] total_candidates_tested reflects early stopping at the planted seeds; the attacker's work is 2 * 2^18 (separable) versus 2^36 (joint), not log2(total_tested)

e5_s0_ciphertext_only_d65536.description: S0 ciphertext-only: ONE exact ciphertext latent, no plaintext. Score each candidate sign key by sum_i k'_i c_i / (rms(c) sqrt(d)); the latent's positive mean makes the correct key an outlier.
e5_s0_ciphertext_only_d65536.note: [fact] a single ciphertext latent is enough; score is already in sigma units (wrong keys ~ N(0,1))

e6_s1_ciphertext_only_d65536.description: S1 ciphertext-only from ONE ciphertext: stage 1 finds the permutation seed by the adjacent-pixel correlation of the inverse-permuted |c| (restored spatial structure); stage 2 finds the sign seed with the S0 score on the de-permuted latent. No plaintext, no key reuse.
e6_s1_ciphertext_only_d65536.note: [fact] a single S1 ciphertext suffices; no key reuse required (stronger than the >=10 ciphertexts earlier estimated)

legacy_seed_positions.note: [inference] positions of the legacy password-derived seeds (A3.1 V1) in an ascending enumeration of all 2^32 seeds; an attacker without the password would not know the position and expects to test 2^31 candidates on average

timing_nondeterministic.note: machine dependent; excluded from determinism comparison

extrapolation_to_2_32.assumptions: [assumption] linear in the number of candidates, single thread, no per-candidate oracle cost beyond key regeneration/screening; scales ~linearly with cores only if candidates are split across workers

ciphertext_only_extrapolation.assumptions: [assumption] wrong candidates score ~ N(0,1); the expected maximum over M candidates is about sqrt(2 ln M). For M = 2^32 that is ~6.66 sigma, far below the correct key's score, so the correct key stays rank 1 at full scale. CPU single thread.

conclusion: [事實] 在縮小至 2^20 的 seed 空間中，以一對已知明文/密文 latent，窮舉重新產生前作金鑰即可找回祕密 seed：d=4096 簡單窮舉測試 809,561 個候選後找回 seed 809560；d=65536（真實 latent）以 64 座標預篩加全維驗證，測試 580,345 個候選後找回 seed 580344；祕密 seed 在範圍外的 negative control 掃完 2^20 個候選皆無結果；S1 把符號 seed 與置換 seed 分開搜尋，共 156,997 個候選（聯合搜尋為 2^36）即找回兩者。[事實] 唯密文（COA，無任何明文）：S0 單一密文 latent 的正確金鑰分數 37.1σ，2^14 個錯誤候選最高僅 3.7σ，正確金鑰排第 1；S1 單一密文分兩階段，置換 seed 12.0σ、符號 seed 37.0σ，皆排第 1，不需金鑰重用。分數本身即以 σ 為單位（錯誤金鑰 ~ N(0,1)）。[推定] 2^32 個 N(0,1) 錯誤候選的期望最大值約 6.7σ，仍遠低於正確金鑰，故全尺度下正確金鑰仍排第 1；外推時間見 timing_nondeterministic（CPU 單執行緒，非 GPU）。[結論] 前作在 T1 下不需要已知明文：單一密文即可在 32-bit seed 空間中辨識金鑰，密碼強度幾乎無關。
